findings.raw: Local copy gate1_validate() uses substring matching (frag.lower() in logs.lower()) but production check_gate1_aggregate() (e2e_voice_test.sh:442-443, after 187c9a35) uses tool_invoked(logs, frag) which requires quoted/marker names (e.g. 'generate_music', 'Запрос выполнения: generate_music'). Unit tests TestGate1Validator (lines 155-239) pass against stale local copy with fixtures like 'Calling MCP tool: generate_music' (no quotes/markers) but production tool_invoked() rejects the same input. Tests silently lie: they claim to validate ADR-0022 GATE-1 but validate a different function. Docstring line 47 cites 'строки 740-770' (stale — actual code is at lines 385-522).

Test fixtures like 'Calling MCP tool: generate_music' pass under local substring validator but FAIL under production tool_invoked() (no quotes, no markers). Root cause same as gate1_validate stale local copy — fixed together in issue #2388.

Integration tests TestGate1AggregateIntegration.test_aggregate_pass_when_expected_called and test_aggregate_fail_when_renardo_called run real e2e_voice_test.sh which requires WAKE_GATE_CLEARED=1 (e2e_voice_test.sh:1285) and thus real audio recording. They fail in dev containers without audio hardware (GATE-1: ⏭ SKIP — wake-gate cold-start not cleared). Designed for CI-only but not marked with @pytest.mark.skipif(not AUDIO_HARDWARE_AVAILABLE). Should be annotated so local runs (without audio) skip cleanly instead of failing.

Docstring references 'Синхронна с тем, что в e2e_voice_test.sh (строки 740-770)'. Actual check_gate1_aggregate code is at lines 385-522 of e2e_voice_test.sh (post-187c9a35). Fix is included in #2388 (replace local copy with import).

Helper function _load(path) for YAML/JSON appears in 3+ test files: test_image_versions_sha_contract.py:60, test_workflow_refactor_acceptance.py:75, test_l_build_service_composite.py:33 (_load_action_yaml). Pattern is one-shot per-file (each helper does single open() + yaml.safe_load). No shared tests/unit/conftest.py / _shared/ / utils/ exists for this component. Not a defect — pattern is consistent across all 5 test files reviewed. Suggestion (no-real-defect): if a shared helper ever materializes, refactor in follow-up. Decided NOT to open issue Шифу.

@pytest.fixture immediately follows class TestDiffAgainstYaml end without blank line. Python is fine with this (still module-scope), but visually confusing. tests/unit is supposed to be read often; cosmetic only. Suggestion (no-real-defect).

TestGate1AggregateIntegration (2 tests) require real Yandex TTS synth to reach aggregate check. With fake YANDEX_API_KEY (env), script bails at step s1: FAIL (синтез Yandex упал YANDEX_AUTHERROR) before reaching check_gate1_aggregate. Tests were green in original CI with real Yandex key. Locally with fake key — environmental failure. NOT introduced by the diff (pre-existing design). Same root cause as test_aggregate_pass_when_expected_called audio-hardware requirement.
